items.title: How to Use Dermalogica Deep Breakout Liquid Patch (5% Sulfur) #shorts
items.lead: Dermalogica Deep Breakout Liquid Patch: an invisible liquid patch with 5% colloidal sulfur, applied as soon as you feel a blemish forming to help stop breakouts before you can even see them.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Deep Breakout Liquid Patch: what's in it and how to use it.
facts: Apply as soon as you feel a blemish forming, to help stop breakouts before you can even see them (14 ml)
5% colloidal sulfur helps combat breakouts for rapid skin clearing; 4% niacinamide helps soothe skin and fade post-breakout marks
Skin-mimicking film forms a semi-permeable patch that allows airflow while protecting skin from pollution and irritants; camphor delivers a cooling sensation
Dab a rice-sized amount on deep breakouts, rub in until invisible, allow one minute to dry down, repeat as needed
Do not use near eyes or lips

scenes.caption: Deep Breakout Liquid Patch
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Deep Breakout Liquid Patch. You apply it as soon as you feel a blemish forming, to help stop breakouts before you can even see them.

scenes.caption: 5% colloidal sulfur
scenes.say: Five percent colloidal sulfur helps combat breakouts for rapid skin clearing, and four percent niacinamide helps soothe skin and fade post-breakout marks.

scenes.caption: Invisible liquid patch
scenes.say: A skin-mimicking film forms a semi-permeable patch that allows airflow, while protecting skin from pollution and irritants. Camphor gives a cooling sensation.

scenes.caption: Rice-sized amount
scenes.say: To use it, put a rice-sized amount on the back of your hand. Dab a little on deep breakouts and rub it in until it's invisible.

scenes.caption: One minute to dry
scenes.say: Allow one minute to dry down, and repeat as needed through the day. Don't use it near your eyes or lips. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Sebum Clearing Masque Review: 0.5% Salicylic Acid, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Sebum Clearing Masque: a soothing clay masque with 0.5% salicylic acid that helps clear breakouts and minimize premature signs of skin aging.
items.hook: A full look at the Dermalogica Sebum Clearing Masque.
facts: Soothing clay masque that helps clear breakouts and minimize premature signs of skin aging
Salicylic acid 0.50% clears pore congestion while oil-absorbing clays (kaolin, bentonite) help detoxify skin
Oat and bisabolol help soothe aggravation brought on by breakouts; safflower oil helps counter fine dehydration lines
Licorice and niacinamide help even skin tone
Apply a smooth layer to cleansed face and throat, avoiding the eyes, 3 times a week (or just the T-zone); leave on 10 minutes, rinse with warm water

scenes.caption: Sebum Clearing Masque
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Sebum Clearing Masque. In the next few minutes, we'll go through what it does, what's inside, and exactly how to use it.

scenes.caption: Soothing clay masque
scenes.say: It's a soothing clay masque. It helps clear breakouts, and it helps minimize premature signs of skin aging. So it's made for skin dealing with breakouts and early signs of aging at the same time.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid 0.5%
scenes.say: The active ingredient is salicylic acid, at zero point five percent. Salicylic acid clears pore congestion.

scenes.caption: Kaolin + bentonite clays
scenes.say: Alongside it are oil-absorbing clays, kaolin and bentonite, which help detoxify the skin. They're the second and third ingredients on the list, right after water.

scenes.caption: Oat + bisabolol
scenes.say: Breakouts can leave skin aggravated. Calming botanicals, like oat and bisabolol, help soothe that aggravation.

scenes.caption: Safflower oil
scenes.say: Safflower oil helps counter fine dehydration lines.

scenes.caption: Licorice + niacinamide
scenes.say: And the masque also contains licorice and niacinamide, which help even skin tone.

scenes.caption: Cleanse first
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. Start with clean skin, then apply a smooth layer to your face and throat, avoiding the eye area.

scenes.caption: Three times a week
scenes.say: Use it three times a week. If only your T-zone gets oily or congested, you can use it on the T-zone alone.

scenes.caption: Leave on 10 minutes
scenes.say: Leave it on for ten minutes, then rinse thoroughly with warm water.

scenes.caption: What to use after
scenes.say: Afterward, follow with the AGE Bright Clearing Serum or the Oil Free Matte SPF30.

scenes.caption: The link is in the description
scenes.say: That's the Sebum Clearing Masque: zero point five percent salicylic acid, oil-absorbing clays, oat and bisabolol to soothe, and ten minutes, three times a week. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Retinol Clearing Oil Review: Retinol + Salicylic Acid, How to Use It

items.hook: A full look at the Dermalogica Retinol Clearing Oil.
facts: Slow-release retinol works all night to help optimize skin recovery and reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and hyperpigmentation
Salicylic acid targets active breakouts to help clear skin
Lipid-based delivery system with skin-mimicking phytoactive lipids from argan, rosehip seed and golden jojoba oils
At night, after cleansing, dispense 6-10 drops and smooth over face and neck, avoiding the eye area

scenes.caption: Retinol Clearing Oil
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Retinol Clearing Oil. In the next few minutes, we'll go through what it does, what's inside, and exactly how to use it.

scenes.caption: Two jobs, one oil
scenes.say: It's a face oil with two jobs. Retinol works on skin recovery and signs of aging, and salicylic acid targets active breakouts.

scenes.caption: Slow-release retinol
scenes.say: The retinol is slow-release, and it works all night to help optimize skin recovery.

scenes.caption: Fine lines + hyperpigmentation
scenes.say: It helps reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and hyperpigmentation.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid
scenes.say: Then there's salicylic acid, which targets active breakouts to help clear skin.

scenes.caption: Lipid-based delivery
scenes.say: All of this is powered by a lipid-based delivery system, which actively nourishes the skin with skin-mimicking phytoactive lipids.

scenes.caption: Argan, rosehip, jojoba
scenes.say: Those lipids come from three oils: argan, rosehip seed, and golden jojoba.

scenes.caption: Use it at night
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. This one is for the evening. At night, after cleansing, it goes on clean skin.

scenes.caption: Press and release
scenes.say: Press the button and release it to fill the dropper. Then gently press the button again to dispense six to ten drops into your hands.

scenes.caption: Face and neck
scenes.say: Smooth the oil over your face and neck, avoiding the eye area.

scenes.caption: Overnight
scenes.say: The slow-release retinol then works all night, while you sleep.

scenes.caption: The link is in the description
scenes.say: That's the Retinol Clearing Oil: slow-release retinol, salicylic acid for active breakouts, argan, rosehip and jojoba oils, and six to ten drops at night. The link is in the description.
